description:
Did an arrangement of Miss from Super Mario World. Had this on my PC for a while, and I thought I'd just finish and release it.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:

‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. B Major (Custom Pitch 2)
